title: No outside market line joined
detail: No bookmaker or prediction-market quote could be joined to this fixture by name and start time. The pick therefore rests on our own originated line, or is withheld.

title: No originated line
detail: Neither the official Valve Regional Standings pair nor the official HLTV ranking pair is complete for both teams, so no own line is published.

title: Two quotes equally close
detail: Two outside quotes join this fixture with start times less than a minute apart; the higher-ranked source was used and the tie is disclosed.

title: Stale listing
detail: The payload still lists the fixture but its start time is days in the past. It is published as a stale listing, not as a pickable match.

title: Series length not stated
detail: Hotspawn does not state a best-of length for this fixture, so the own line is published per map and labelled as such.

title: Markup-only fixture id
detail: The id is rendered on the page but is absent from the TransferState payload, so it cannot be confirmed.

title: Name variant joined
detail: The source spells a team differently from the fixture (for example an abbreviation); the join used the repository's documented alias table and the fixture's start time, and both spellings are shown on the row.

title: Market and own line diverge
detail: The joined outside line and our own originated line differ by 12.5 percentage points or more. The market line is published as the probability; the own line is shown next to it and never averaged in.

title: Result disagreement with the verification trail
detail: The score in the Hotspawn payload and the independently verified result on file disagree. Both are linked; neither is overwritten.

title: Result not independently cross-checked
detail: A score is published in the payload but no independently verified result is on file yet for this fixture.
